description: This is a 3D rendering of a vanity table. The table features a rectangular structure with a clear mirror mounted on top. The mirror is bordered by a series of light bulbs arranged around its perimeter, creating a well-lit area for makeup application or grooming. The table itself has a simple, minimalist design, with straight lines and a clean, unadorned surface. There are several circular indentations along the top surface of the table, potentially to hold makeup brushes or other beauty products. The color is a muted gray-white, giving the piece a neutral and versatile aesthetic.
